security.pageDescription: How your payout addresses are protected, and every change made to them.
security.profileLinkBody: See how your payout addresses are protected, every change made to them, and sign out of other devices.
security.frozenBody: You (or someone with your email) reported a payout address change as not yours, so we restored the previous address and froze edits. Contact support to unlock.
security.levelSubtitle: How your payout addresses are protected right now.
security.levelLockedBody: Payout address changes are frozen after a “this wasn't me” report. Contact support to unlock.
security.levelStrongBody: Every payout address change needs a one-time code, emails you an undo link, and your sign-in has two-factor protection.
security.levelStandardBody: Every payout address change needs a one-time code and emails you an undo link. Turn on two-factor sign-in to reach Strong.
security.checkOtp: A one-time code is required for every payout address change
security.checkAlerts: Every change emails you with a one-tap undo
security.turnOn2faHint: Two-factor sign-in protects your payouts even if your password leaks.
security.step1Body: Adding, editing or removing a payout address always asks for a one-time code sent to you first.
security.step2Body: An alert goes to your account email with the old and new address and a one-tap “This wasn't me” link. Alerts can't be switched off.
security.step2BodyEmail: An alert goes to {{email}} with the old and new address and a one-tap “This wasn't me” link. Alerts can't be switched off.
security.step3Body: If it wasn't you, that link restores the previous address and locks further payout address changes until support confirms it's really you.
security.historySubtitle: Who changed what, and when — for the selected brand.
security.historyOwnerOnly: Only the brand owner can see payout address change history.
security.historyEmpty: No payout address changes yet. Every add, edit or removal will show up here with who did it and when.
security.devicesHint: If you see a device you don't recognise, sign out everywhere else and change your password.
security.signedOutCount: Signed out on {{count}} other device(s) — you're still signed in here.
security.noOtherDevices: No other devices to sign out.
security.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign out other devices. Please try again.
security.stripLocked: Payout address changes are frozen after a “this wasn't me” report.
security.stripStrong: One-time code on every change · undo link by email · two-factor sign-in on.
security.stripStandard: One-time code on every change · undo link by email. Turn on two-factor sign-in to reach Strong.
